_readme: Monthly ClinVar archives loaded into the kb graph. Monthly releases are published usually on the first Thursday of the month and copied to archive/ (ClinVar FTP README); weekly files are not archived, so only monthly archives are used (replayable).
Sizes verified on 18 Oct 2026 by directory listing. file_sha256 is filled in by scripts/extract_clinvar.py when it downloads the file and is stored on the Release node (K3).

eval_only.note: used only to build eval/transitions_2024-10_2026-10.tsv; not loaded into kb; has 15 columns (no ContributesToAggregateClassification)

next_expected.note: first Thursday of November; the Watcher polls the archive listing daily and ingests it as a DELTA during the judging window
